prerelease.note: Ren'Py 8.6.0 is not released. This is the nightly built from renpy-build master and the Ren'Py commit above; renpy-build has no tag for it. 'dirty' only reflects generated files in the nightly's checkout: every Python source in the SDK equals the commit's, apart from the generated renpy/styledata/stylesets.py.

renpy_uv_lock.note: Ren'Py removed uv.lock from version control (renpy 9fb435f). Resolved with uv 0.12.3 for the commit's pyproject.toml with --exclude-newer 2026-10-04T03:53:10Z (the commit time), then urllib3 2.7.0, idna 3.18, websockets 17.1 and charset-normalizer 3.4.9 pinned to the versions the nightly SDK ships. The pip task reads its versions from this file.

renpy_sdk.note: Nightly SDKs have no LICENSE.txt; the license text is the commit's sphinx/source/license.rst, the source of the official SDKs' LICENSE.txt.

live2d_header.note: Compile time only, for renpy.gl2.live2dmodel; not redistributed. Upstream's live2d task uses the same CubismSdkForNative-5-r.5.

upstream_renios.note: Upstream's iOS prebuilt archives from the same nightly; baseline for the system import gate only.
